assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md
src/review-classifier.ts calls `decide(...)` with a `choice` question and reads `answer.choice` and `answer.probabilities`; no `.includes("spam")`-style matching on generated text remains.

src/review-question.ts defines a single `choice` question over spam/abusive/fine where "Spam takes precedence when a review is both spam and abusive", and the README admits "If both labels must be returned simultaneously, use separate binary questions instead."

`gateReview` only takes `minimumProbability` as a caller-supplied parameter, and the README states "No production thresholds are supplied" (its baseline just returns `decision.label`), so no threshold values actually live in code next to the probabilities.
